🚨BREAKING: Hezbollah MP Ibrahim Moussawi tells me, "We will be respecting the ceasefire," and says the deal is based on the original agreement between the US and Iran that a ceasefire would apply to Lebanon.

FULL COMMENTS of Ibrahim Moussawi, Member of Lebanese Parliament, Loyalty to the Resistance Bloc:

"They went back to the same ceasefire agreement that has been reached to in Islamabad by the Iranian initiative.

"We will be respecting the ceasefire and we will deal with it cautiously, actu

Significant that Moussawi says this ceasefire is based on the original Iranian deal reached with the US April 7, not a new framework. Trump and Netanyahu claimed Lebanon would not be included, despite the fact that it was officially announced as part of the Iran ceasefire deal.

Moussawi & Hezbollah have been very critical of the Lebanese government for engaging in direct meetings with Israel. Moussawi says this is not a new deal, but rather a return to the original agreement made with Iran on April 7 to include Lebanon. Here is our earlier story:

www.youtube.com/live/wGSbAOX...

Status of the Gaza ceasefire talks: Israel, via Arab mediators, is pushing for a short term deal with only loose language about it leading to a potential end of the war. Hamas is offering a proposal for a comprehensive, multi-year truce & detailed responses to Israel's positions.
